list.name: repo
list.query: SELECT repo FROM repos ORDER BY repo

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time/86400*86400 AS time, 1.0*sum(c.value->>'covered')/sum(c.value->>'total') AS coverage FROM snapshots,json_each(metrics,'$.coverage') c WHERE repo IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND time BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Lint per thousand lines by tool

targets.rawQueryText: WITH s AS (SELECT time/86400*86400 day,metrics,(SELECT sum(value->>'lines') FROM json_each(metrics,'$.loc')) loc FROM snapshots WHERE repo IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND time BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 AND json_type(metrics,'$.lint')='array'), tags AS (SELECT DISTINCT j.value->>'tool' tag FROM s,json_each(metrics,'$.lint') j) SELECT day AS time,tag AS metric,1000.0*sum(coalesce((SELECT sum(value->>'count') FROM json_each(metrics,'$.lint') WHERE value->>'tool'=tag),0))/sum(loc) AS value FROM s,tags WHERE loc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY day,tag ORDER BY day,tag

panels.title: Smells per thousand lines by kind

targets.rawQueryText: WITH s AS (SELECT time/86400*86400 day,metrics,(SELECT sum(value->>'lines') FROM json_each(metrics,'$.loc')) loc FROM snapshots WHERE repo IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND time BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 AND json_type(metrics,'$.smells')='array'), tags AS (SELECT DISTINCT j.value->>'kind' tag FROM s,json_each(metrics,'$.smells') j) SELECT day AS time,tag AS metric,1000.0*sum(coalesce((SELECT sum(value->>'count') FROM json_each(metrics,'$.smells') WHERE value->>'kind'=tag),0))/sum(loc) AS value FROM s,tags WHERE loc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY day,tag ORDER BY day,tag

SELECT time/86400*86400 AS time, 1.0*sum(metrics->>'$.duplication.duplicated')/sum(metrics->>'$.duplication.total') AS duplicated FROM snapshots WHERE repo IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND time BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (time+259200)/604800*604800-259200 AS time,sum(pr) AS pull_request,sum(1-pr) AS direct FROM changes WHERE repo IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND time BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH RECURSIVE days(t) AS (SELECT $__from / 86400000 * 86400 UNION ALL SELECT t+86400 FROM days WHERE t+86400 <= $__to/1000) SELECT t AS time, avg(1.0*revert) AS rate, 0.005 AS reference FROM days LEFT JOIN changes ON repo IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND changes.time>t-90*86400 AND changes.time<=t GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Hits per week by check and actor

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (time+259200)/604800*604800-259200 AS time,name||' · '||CASE WHEN agent IS NULL THEN 'person' ELSE 'agent' END AS metric,count(*) AS value FROM failures WHERE repo IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND time BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Checks without a hit in 90 days

targets.rawQueryText: WITH inventory AS (SELECT * FROM checks UNION SELECT repo,name FROM failures UNION SELECT repo,name FROM repos CROSS JOIN rules) SELECT repo,name FROM inventory i WHERE repo IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM failures f WHERE f.repo=i.repo AND f.name=i.name AND time>=unixepoch('now','-90 days')) ORDER BY repo,name

panels.title: Check duration by repo and mode

targets.rawQueryText: WITH runs AS (SELECT repo,event->>'mode' mode,event->>'seconds' seconds,unixepoch(event->>'time') time FROM hits WHERE event->>'source'='check' AND repo IN (${repo:sqlstring})), ranked AS (SELECT *,row_number() OVER w n,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY repo,mode) size FROM runs WHERE time BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000 WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY repo,mode ORDER BY seconds)) SELECT repo,mode,avg(CASE WHEN n IN ((size+1)/2,(size+2)/2) THEN seconds END) median,max(CASE WHEN n=(95*size+99)/100 THEN seconds END) p95 FROM ranked GROUP BY repo,mode ORDER BY repo,mode

panels.title: Repos that have not adopted Assay

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT repo FROM repos WHERE repo IN (${repo:sqlstring}) AND state='unadopted' ORDER BY repo
